apps.title: Apps
apps.description: Google Play package IDs (e.g. com.whatsapp) or full store URLs (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.whatsapp). One entry per app.

sort.title: Sort order
sort.description: Newest returns reviews in reverse chronological order (best for monitoring). Relevance mirrors the default order on the store page.

starsFilter.title: Star rating filter
starsFilter.description: Only return reviews with this star rating (1 to 5). Leave on all ratings for everything. 1 star rows are where the churn reasons and bug reports live.

language.title: Language
language.description: Review language code, e.g. en, es, fr, de, pt. Controls which localized reviews Play returns.

country.title: Country
country.description: Two letter country code, e.g. us, gb, in, br, de.

maxReviewsPerApp.title: Max reviews per app
maxReviewsPerApp.description: Cap on review rows per app.

maxRows.title: Max rows total
maxRows.description: Maximum review rows across all apps. First 2 rows per run are free.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The endpoint works from datacenter IPs and requests are paced, so proxy is off by default.
